title: Ion drive: The first flight
summary: Nature video showing MIT researchers flying the first plane with no moving parts, powered by an ion drive that creates an ionic wind from high-powered electrodes. The 5m-wide craft flies across a sports hall.
why: Linked as a quick demonstration of the ion plane in threads about silent aircraft and flying cars.
